sophia: +1. short steps + stable cohort mapping please.

alan: propose payload: steps array + gates + dry_run flag. return rollout_id.

rei: sampling must be deterministic: hash(rollout_id, request_id) < pct. persist decision TTL.

sam: rollback default = step_back. auto-pause on signal breach. console shows timeline + dry-run cost estimate.

ops-bot: Incident 1768805000 referenced. add rollout_id to logs/traces.

omar: coordinator lock per-route. If lock present return 409 with ETA.

sophia: audit: append immutable step events with snapshots, retention 90d.

alan: metrics: rollout.progress, rollout.health, rollout.pauses. wire alerts.

rei: PoC: small coordinator + runtime hook behind feature flag, shadow to ops.

sam: I'll stub telemetry gates (p95, error rate) and pair on PoC.

omar: I'll draft RFC and console mocks. linking: https://git.redwood/internal/rfcs/rollouts/progressive-17699 :thumbsup:
